## Session map: 120 minutes

| Module | Time | Core question |
|---|---:|---|
| Definitions and service architecture | 10 min | What makes a service “added value”? |
| High-accuracy services | 25 min | Which errors are corrected, and how does the user apply them? |
| Authentication | 25 min | What can a receiver authenticate, and what does that not prove? |
| Precise products and external correction delivery | 30 min | How are precise orbit, clock, troposphere and ionosphere products generated and delivered? |
| Integrity and safety services | 25 min | How does a system bound the risk of an unsafe position? |
| Synthesis and questions | 5 min | Which service fits a given user requirement? |
